title: AI and Business Process Strategic Portfolio Integrator
description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary
The Strategic Portfolio Integrator is the connective layer across the CRO AI and Business Process Transformation portfolio. This role brings order and pace to a fast-moving set of technology and AI-enabled initiatives spanning marketing, sales, customer success, value engineering, and partner, ensuring every request is understood, prioritized against ROI, sequenced, and tracked through delivery. The Integrator acts as the single point of contact for CRO requests, translating raw asks into clear scope, and as a strategic advisor to the Senior Director of GTM AI Transformation and the Director of Business Process Excellence on where the team should focus next.

This is a business orchestration role, not a technical execution role. The Integrator ensures the portfolio reflects GTM strategy and delivers measurable revenue and productivity impact, working in close partnership with our Digital Innovation Office on technical delivery timelines without owning technical architecture.

Responsibilities

- Serve as single point of contact for CRO technology and AI-related requests, quickly understanding intent at a high level and translating it into clear, actionable scope

- Stitch together the broader portfolio of technology and AI support requests into a coherent, prioritized view

- Support curation of business cases with defensible ROI tied to cost reduction, cost avoidance, or revenue growth, grounded in methodology rather than assumption

- Tie portfolio priorities back to GTM strategy, ensuring the work being resourced is the work that matters most

- Support process optimization work directly where extra capacity is needed across the team

- Recommend how incoming requests should be triaged, whether through AI optimization, process optimization, or tool optimization, and help focus the portfolio on the highest-value requests

- Track all CRO requests across the prioritization and delivery pipeline, and communicate status clearly to executives and senior stakeholders

- Act as strategic advisor to the Senior Director of GTM AI Transformation and Director of Business Process Excellence on sequencing and prioritization

- Keep delivery on track and at pace across teams, surfacing risks and unblocking dependencies before they stall progress

Qualifications

- 10+ years experience in a combination of GTM Ops or RevOps, with working knowledge of end-to-end CRO processes across marketing, sales, technical sales, customer success, and partner organizations

- Familiarity with process optimization frameworks and a rigorous approach to business case development

- Comfort operating in a complex, highly matrixed environment with competing stakeholder priorities and urgent, high-visibility requests

- Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to translate portfolio status into clear, confident updates for senior leaders

- A bias toward pace and follow-through, able to keep multiple workstreams moving without losing sight of strategic intent

- Strong ability to evaluate and prioritize portfolio investments through opportunity sizing, ROI Analysis, and rigorous business case development

- Working knowledge of Salesforce at scale; familiarity with Gainsight and the ability to self-serve analysis, measurement, and trend identification

Equinix Benefits
As an employee, you become important to Equinix’s success. We ensure all your benefits are in line with our core values: competitive, inclusive, sustainable, connected and efficient. We keep them competitive within the current marketplace to ensure we’re providing you with the best package possible. So, wherever you are in your career and life, you’ll be able to enhance your experience and bring your whole self to work.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific plan or program terms.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits. Benefits are subject to specific plan or program terms, and to change at Equinix discretion.
